summary: Santander UK Group Holdings PLC filed a 6-K announcing four appointments to its Executive Committee, including a new CFO (Tom Ranger), Chief Accounting Officer (Steve Affleck), Chief Compliance Officer (Michael Christodoulides), and Head of Cards Payments (Iñaki Perkins). Current CFO Angel Santodomingo will resign as Executive Director effective October 31, 2026, and move to Banco Santander in January 2027. The changes aim to align the bank's structure with Banco Santander's model amid TSB integration. Although multiple C-suite moves occur, the CFO departure/transition is orderly and not forced/abrupt, and no activist, strategic review, or M&A event is triggered. Routine leadership refresh.
